content: ragg 1.5.2 (CRAN, 2026-03-23): AGG-based graphics device for PNG/JPEG/TIFF. Hard imports systemfonts >= 1.0.3 and textshaping >= 0.3.0. System requirements: freetype2, libpng, libtiff, libjpeg, libwebp. Provides ragg_png, ragg_jpeg, ragg_tiff devices. Anti-aliased text rendering. pkgdown imports ragg directly. For R Markdown: dev='ragg_png' in chunk options. ggsave() uses ragg automatically if installed. Not suitable for PDF output (limitation acknowledged). Dev-only for package development context; may be Suggests in a package that generates reports.
